age_limit.details: Candidates should not have completed more than 60 years as on 01/10/2026. For Retired Railway Doctors as CMPs, the number of terms of engagement is seven terms subject to the age limit of 67 years.

how_to_apply: Download the official notification PDF and review the attached application format.
Fill out the application form in the specified format with all required details.

Gather attested copies of your certificate indicating date of birth (SSLC Certificate), M.B.B.S. Degree and Degree Certificate of higher medical qualification, Internship Certificate, Registration Certificate, caste certificate in prescribed proforma (if applicable), and experience certificate.
Ensure you carry your original certificates for verification at the venue.
Report in person to the Principal Chief Medical Officer, ICF Hospital, Chennai-600038 for the walk-in interview on 23/10/2026.
important_instructions: The engagement is on a Full Time Contract basis for a period of one year or less or till regularly IRHS Anesthetist is available or till the scheme is available, whichever is earlier. Services are liable for termination before expiry by giving 15 days notice by either side without assigning any reason. No private practice is allowed. Contract doctors shall not be entitled to Railway Quarters, etc. Period of contract is not extendable on any grounds, though the Railway administration reserves the right to enter into fresh contract for another term. The CMP shall undergo a medical examination before the contract is entered into. The selected doctor must produce character and antecedents certificates from two gazetted officers of the Central or State Government and original certificates for date of birth and qualifications. The CMP shall have to undergo a brief orientation for a period of two weeks. The selected candidate will not have any claim or right for continuity in service or automatic extension of the term of contract.

faq.question: Q1. What is ICF Specialist (Anaesthesia) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by Integral Coach Factory (ICF) to engage one Full Time Medical Practitioner (Specialist Anaesthesia) on a contract basis at Railway Hospital, ICF, Chennai.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Specialist (Anaesthesia) post.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 23/10/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.B.B.S. degree, registration with the Indian Medical Council, and a specialization in Anesthesiology (MD/DA/DNB). Two years of experience is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must not have completed more than 60 years as on 01/10/2026. For retired railway doctors, the age limit is 67 years subject to a maximum of seven terms.
